package.name: surgical_task_interfaces
package.description:
Message and action types for the surgical robot task coordinator: the TaskState the coordinator broadcasts, and the three long-running robot operations (GraspTool, HandoverTool, SuctionBlood) it drives.
Kept separate from surgical_task_coordinator so the robot-control team can depend on the action definitions without pulling in the coordinator's Python code. These are PNU-internal orchestration types -- they are NOT the ARPA-H inter-organization contract. Perception results exchanged between organizations use surgical_msgs/* and the /surgery/perception/... topic names in the ARPA-H interface table.
